chapter: Teaching, the 1951 Big Show and New York nights
title: Ellington band on the 1951 Big Show; Paul Gonsalves as guitarist
summary: Touring with Nat Cole and Duke Ellington's band, Collins notes Paul Gonsalves was a good guitarist and played Collins's guitar.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: I'm sure I will enjoy that. But coming back to travelling now, I'm going to go back with the Big Show now. This is the big Show of '51. We travelled with -- it was Nat Cole, Duke Ellington, and quite a few acts, but I'm not interested in acts now. Duke Ellington's band. This was a great band, this particular band was a great band. And this was -- band was Louie Bellson, Wendell Marshall, I believe, Shorty Baker, Cooke, what's his name.
Willie Cooke, Willie Smith, Procope and of course Carnaby, and Paul Gonzales. Now, I have a -- I felt very close to Paul because Paul is a good guitarist. I don't know whether you realize it.
Paul was a very good guitarist, yes, yes. I think that that was his original instrument. Yes, see, you didn't know that.

I used to give him my guitar and say play for them, Paul, and he played very good. Yeah. But this band -- it was a thrill to work with him. I could hardly wait to get to the concert every night to listen to this band. And Strayhorn was travelling with the band also, and it was --
